title: Besan Laddu
description: Melt-in-the-mouth gram flour laddus roasted slowly in ghee and rolled with powdered sugar and cardamom.
steps: Heat the ghee in a heavy pan on low heat and add the besan.
Roast, stirring constantly, for 15 to 20 minutes until it turns golden, smells nutty and becomes loose and sandy.
Turn off the heat and stir in the almonds and cardamom; let the mixture cool until warm to touch.
Add the powdered sugar and mix thoroughly with your hands.
Shape into 12 equal laddus while the mixture is still warm, pressing firmly.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar for up to 2 weeks.
